verses.en: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.
verses.pt: Salva-me, ó Deus, pelo teu nome, e faze-me justiça pelo teu poder.
verses.en_web: Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker; on Neginoth. Maschil. Of David. When the Ziphites came and said to Saul, Is not David keeping himself secret among us?> Let your name be my salvation, O God; let my cause be judged by your strength.

verses.en: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.pt: Ó Deus, ouve a minha oração, dá ouvidos às palavras da minha boca.
verses.en_web: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.
verses.en_bbe: Let my prayer come before you, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.en: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.
verses.pt: Porque homens insolentes se levantam contra mim, e violentos procuram a minha vida; eles não põem a Deus diante de si.
verses.en_web: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: For men who are going after me have come out against me, violent men are purposing to take my soul; they have not put God before their eyes. (Selah.)

verses.en: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.
verses.pt: Eis que Deus é o meu ajudador; o Senhor é quem sustenta a minha vida.
verses.en_web: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
verses.en_bbe: See, God is my helper: the Lord is the great supporter of my soul.

verses.en: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
verses.pt: Faze recair o mal sobre os meus inimigos; destrói-os por tua verdade.
verses.en_web: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
verses.en_bbe: Let the evil works of my haters come back on them again; let them be cut off by your good faith.

verses.en: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for it is good.
verses.pt: De livre vontade te oferecerei sacrifícios; louvarei o teu nome, ó Senhor, porque é bom.
verses.en_web: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, Yahweh, for it is good.
verses.en_bbe: Freely will I make my offerings to you; I will give praise to your name, O Lord, for it is good.

verses.en: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.
verses.pt: Porque tu me livraste de toda a angústia; e os meus olhos viram a ruína dos meus inimigos.
verses.en_web: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
verses.en_bbe: Because it has been my saviour from all my trouble; and my eyes have seen the punishment of my haters.
